build_bytetracker: build a ByteTracker instance with configurable score thresholds and IOU matching parameters for object tracking
track_bytetracker: run the ByteTracker track method on a DetDataSample to associate detections across frames with instance IDs
assign_ids_bytetracker: assign tracking IDs to detections using bipartite matching with IOU distance and category constraints
init_track_bytetracker: initialize a new track with a Kalman Filter state and tentative flag for a detected object
update_track_bytetracker: update an existing track with new detection data and Kalman Filter state estimation
